description.value: Railtown Café has been a fixture in Vancouver's historic Railtown District of the Downtown Eastside since 2012, founded by classically trained chefs Dan Olson and Tyler Day who also run the award-winning Railtown Catering out of the same facility. The café serves heaping portions of scratch-made comfort food — gourmet sandwiches, soups, pastries, and a build-your-own salad bar — using local and organic ingredients. With multiple Vancouver locations and a community-focused ethos, it's a well-regarded stop for a filling, quality meal.

Vegetarian, vegan, and GF options are confirmed by the menu page listing Vegan Avocado Toast, Vegetarian Soup, and the note '*Gluten free options available'. A postal code discrepancy exists (OSM: V6A 1A4 vs. website contact page: V6A 1C2), and the contact page lists a second phone number (604-568-8811) for the HQ office, distinct from the OSM/footer number (604-428-0800) which is labelled for directions/café.
